name: AI-Powered Assignment Grading & Rubric Evaluation Workflow

parameters.content:
## ⚠️ Error Handler
Catches any failure in the workflow and posts a Slack alert. Wire the error output of critical nodes here to prevent silent failures going unnoticed.

## 🎓 AI Assignment Grader with Personalised Feedback

### How it works
When a student uploads a PDF to a watched Google Drive folder, this workflow automatically extracts the text, grades it against a teacher-defined rubric stored in Google Docs, and emails the student a detailed feedback report — all within 5 minutes. A daily summary is sent to the teacher at 6 PM via Gmail and Telegram.

### Setup steps
1. **Google Drive** — set `folderToWatch` to your submissions folder ID
2. **Google Docs** — update the rubric document URL in the `Get Rubric` node
3. **Google Sheets** — confirm Sheet ID and that a tab named `Gradebook` exists with the correct column headers in row 1
4. **Gmail** — connect OAuth2 credentials; update the teacher summary recipient email
5. **Telegram** — connect your bot and confirm the chat ID is correct
6. **File naming** — students must name files as: `FirstLast__email@domain.com__Assignment_Title__Course.pdf`
7. Activate both triggers and run a test upload to verify end-to-end

## 📂 Trigger & File Download
Watches a Google Drive folder every minute for new PDF uploads. When a file appears, it's immediately downloaded as binary data and passed downstream for text extraction.

## 🧠 AI Text Extraction & Grading
Two sequential AI calls: the first extracts plain text from the PDF binary. The second grades the extracted text against the rubric, returning a structured JSON score with per-criterion breakdown and 3-paragraph personalised feedback.

## 📊 Data Logging
Parses the AI grading response and appends a structured row to the Gradebook sheet. Columns include score breakdown, grade letter, and all three feedback paragraphs. If the AI response fails to parse, fallback values are written so the row is never skipped.

## 📬 Student Notification
Sends a styled HTML email to the student with their grade, score breakdown table, and the three personalised feedback paragraphs. Falls back to a default address if student email is missing from the filename.

## 🕕 Daily Teacher Summary
Runs at 6 PM daily. Reads all Gradebook rows, filters to today's date, builds a grade distribution summary, and sends it to the teacher via Gmail and Telegram. Skips silently if no submissions were graded today.

## 🔐 Credentials & Security
Use OAuth2 for Google Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Gmail. Use Bot Token for Telegram. Never hardcode API keys. Replace all sample emails and IDs with your own before sharing or publishing this template.
